# John Menerick — Principal Security Engineer (Independent Consultant)

> John Menerick is an independent Principal Security Engineer based in Castro Valley,
> California, with 18+ years in information security. He specializes in AI and agent
> security, cloud detection and response, zero-trust architecture, and confidential
> computing. This site is his CV and research portfolio; long-form research is at
> https://www.securesql.info.

## Professional Profile

- [About and experience](https://cv.securesql.info/): roles at Syn Agency, SeedFi, Plastiq,
  Ford Motor Company (Autonomic), Lake Michigan Credit Union, and NetSuite.

## Technical Research & Projects

- [Public contributions](https://cv.securesql.info/projects/): coordinated disclosures in
  Apache Solr/Jetty (SOLR-4861), Apache Batik (BATIK-1023), MediaWiki (CVE-2015-6729),
  jQuery, Square Keywhiz, Google Translate, and Google Glass; botnet C2 research; DEF CON 22
  and 23 talks.
- [Research](https://cv.securesql.info/research/): DARPA Cyber Grand Challenge finalist with Team CodeJitsu (bot Galactica; technical strategist),
  DARPA AIxCC participant, Kubernetes SIG Security, Project Glasswing and the Anthropic
  Cyber Verification Program (member since launch, 2026), open-source identity and
  confidential-AI tooling.

## Credentials & Education

- Current: CISSP (ISC2); CKS and CKA (CNCF); NSA IAM/IEM; US DOJ/FBI Public Trust;
  Professional Google Workspace Administrator; SCJP; Certified ScrumMaster;
  FEMA ICS (IS-100/200/700/800); FCC Amateur Extra (W8MEJ) and GMRS
- Former: Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer (expired); Oracle OCI Foundations,
  AI Foundations, and Data Management Foundations Associate (expired); SANS GXPN, GDAT, GX-IA
- Michigan Technological University — B.S. Computer Systems Science, B.S. Computer
  Science, B.S. Business
